violations.why: ISR overwrites v_onyx with 50 between the init to 0 and the loop-condition read, so the loop exits early.
The condition check can pass, then ISR sets v_onyx to 50, so the index used at line 22 differs from the one checked.
v_onyx++ is a non-atomic read-modify-write; ISR's write is lost or overwritten by the stale increment.
ISR overwrites the incremented value before the loop condition reads it.
ISR changes v_onyx between the index read in the body and the increment read, so the increment is based on a different value.
